name: RFP Response
description: Turn an RFP into a compliant, evidence-backed proposal with requirement traceability, differentiated solution, pricing coordination, review, and submission control.

tasks.name: Ingest solicitation and rules
tasks.objective: Extract submission deadline/time zone, format, page limits, required forms, evaluation criteria, mandatory requirements, questions process, contract terms, pricing format, and disqualifiers.

tasks.name: Build compliance matrix
tasks.objective: Map every requirement and evaluation criterion to response location, owner, evidence, dependencies, open questions, compliance status, and reviewer.

tasks.name: Develop response strategy
tasks.objective: Define customer outcomes, proposed solution, implementation approach, differentiators, proof points, risks, assumptions, exceptions, and win themes grounded in the solicitation.

tasks.name: Draft compliant response
tasks.objective: Write directly to requirements with verifiable evidence, quantified examples where available, consistent terminology, clear assumptions, and no unsupported promises. Coordinate pricing and contractual exceptions.

tasks.name: Run color-team review
tasks.objective: Review compliance, evaluator usability, evidence strength, contradictions, risk, pricing consistency, legal/security claims, readability, page limits, attachments, and required signatures.

tasks.name: Package and submit
tasks.objective: Freeze files, verify naming/format/forms/signatures, run final compliance check, submit through the required channel before deadline, preserve confirmation, and archive the exact submitted set.
